landing.heroStrip3Body: Costs, estimates, and invoices stay aligned.
landing.workflowBottomBody: Customers keep using calls and text messages. Your team gets the organized CRM, calendar, estimate, project, and financial view behind the scenes.
landing.step2DescribeBody: The agent immediately calculates an intelligent estimate analyzing labor, your custom GC margin, and materials. Delivering competitive estimates to clients in seconds instead of days.
landing.featuresPmBody: Tasks, scopes, documents, and crew handoffs stay attached to the project so nothing disappears after the estimate.
landing.featuresProofBody: First-time visitors see the system in plain terms: answer faster, estimate cleaner, dispatch smarter, and keep the money organized.
